newsitem.title: UK: Cathay says not ready to order superjumbo.
newsitem.headline: Cathay says not ready to order superjumbo.

text.p: Far east airline Cathay Pacific said on Tuesday it was not in the market yet for the new superjumbo jets being proposed by aircraft makers Airbus Industrie and Boeing Co although it was likely to be a customer eventually.
"We are in no hurry," managing director Peter Sutch told a news conference at the Farnborough air show.
"I have little doubt that there will be room for a large aircraft in the Cathay fleet but there is still a long way to go in the evaluation process," he added.
